context: Editorial complete chapter validation and accessible field labels: named number/count/seconds placeholders, exact first timestamp0:00, ascending/minimum spacing, beyond-end/name/160-character cases. Include-chapters checkbox name matches the complete instruction, works for upload and URL import. Provider timing/content unchanged.
